E-bike battery basics

Most commuter e-bikes ship with a 36 V or 48 V lithium-ion battery of 400 to 700 watt-hours. A 500 Wh battery typically gives 40 to 60 km of range in pedal-assist mode.

Lifespan

Lithium-ion e-bike batteries are generally rated for 500 to 1,000 full charge cycles before capacity falls to 80% of new. Charging from empty to full takes 4 to 6 hours with the supplied charger.
